title: 13: Teacher app: Indic feedback, robustness signals and UI polish
head: codex/13-indic-robustness-ui
body:
Adds per-assignment Indic feedback, readable robustness signals and teacher UI improvements on top of task 12. The user requested this PR target main. It includes the pending task 12 cleanup until that PR merges; review task 12 first. No history was rewritten.

Done-when coverage:
- The assignment form offers English and the ten Indic languages from `demo.LANGUAGES`. Schema version 3 adds `feedback_language` with English defaults for existing records. Jobs pass the saved language to `Options.language`; translation uses the existing engine and only runs when configured. A missing-key notice appears inline. Tests use a fake translator and verify both translated feedback and its English original persist and render behind “Show English”.
- Answer text uses rubric-language HTML metadata; translated feedback uses the selected target-language code. Noto Sans script fallbacks render Devanagari/Kannada/Tamil and other Indic text without runtime font-CDN requests.
- Review queue/detail show readable flag chips with explanatory tooltips, retaining machine IDs only as data attributes. All/flagged/injection filters are implemented; unresolved critical flags retain their existing priority. Tests cover injection chips, filtering and the other required signal labels.
- Empty/no-file uploads, unsupported extensions, oversized files and duplicate roster rolls return specific friendly 400 responses without partial writes. Invalid rubric sums return a concise 400 error and are flagged client-side before saving. A completed sheet with no recognised answers retains the engine's unanswered grades and shows a notice. No grading/evidence rules changed.
- Empty dashboard/queue illustrations, a three-step “how marking works” panel, J/K/A hint and marked-sheet thumbnail/PDF link keep the existing red-ink identity. Artifact routes retain ownership/path checks. Tests distinguish text answer sources from their generated marked thumbnail.
- `ruff check .` passes. Required installation succeeded. Final `pytest -q`: **298 passed, 1 warning in 93.78s (0:01:33)**. Focused Indic/export checks also pass; public-docstring and web-signature checks remain enforced.
- Browser smoke verified the pre-save rubric warning, Hindi selection, live progress, injection filter, Hindi/English display, valid thumbnail and 390px layout without horizontal overflow. Both task statuses are `in review`.

Screenshots use synthetic public demo cases, scripted grading and an **offline translator fixture**. They demonstrate UI/persistence, not live Bodhan translation quality or new evaluation results. They contain no private student data.

![Dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basavarajnaduvinamani/DA7016_Auto_Assessment_System/codex/13-indic-robustness-ui/docs/development/screenshots/task13/dashboard.png)

![Review queue with injection chip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basavarajnaduvinamani/DA7016_Auto_Assessment_System/codex/13-indic-robustness-ui/docs/development/screenshots/task13/review-injection.png)

![Hindi feedback and English original](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basavarajnaduvinamani/DA7016_Auto_Assessment_System/codex/13-indic-robustness-ui/docs/development/screenshots/task13/hindi-feedback.png)

Implementation notes: answer language comes from the imported/authored exam specification, independently of feedback language. Core grading, provider interfaces, prompt-injection patterns and spend defaults are unchanged. No paid/provider network calls were made. The full run and browser check caught a stylesheet mix-up during editing; the base stylesheet was restored, a regression test added, and screenshots regenerated before completion.


Fresh validation on 2026-10-30 at the unchanged branch tip: `ruff check .` passed; `pytest -q`: 298 passed, 1 warning in 93.78s (0:01:33). These checks do not establish paid-model accuracy.
